text:
maria: Quick sync — planning to cut the release next Wed (2026-05-06). We need API, runtime, console, and SDK bumps to land and cross-repo changelogs updated by EOD Tuesday. Who's blocking?

josh: I have the API PR ready, just waiting on one review. tag: `api@v2.9.0`

tia: Runtime changes landed in my branch but there's one failing unit test on kv-cache. I'll fix it today.

ryan: Console UI needs a small prop rename for the new streaming responses. I can push a patch tomorrow morning.

jen: SDKs — I'm updating the Python client. There is a minor breaking change (param rename) so I need to coordinate docs + changelog.

maria: Thanks. Can we agree on cutoffs: feature PRs freeze Tue 18:00 UTC, final version bumps + changelogs by Tue 23:59 UTC, and branch cut by Wed 02:00 UTC?

josh: Works for me. I'll request a fast-track review if tests pass. :thumbsup:

tia: Agree on times. Ping me if CI is flaky, I'll rerun.

ryan: FYI console deploy pipeline is green, but we should avoid schema changes after the bump.

jen: For the SDK changelog, proposing this header: ```
## v1.14.0 - 2026-05-06
- rename `stream` -> `streaming` param (breaking)
- add `chunked_response` support
```

maria: Looks good. Add links to the API and runtime changelogs, and mark the SDK change as breaking in the top-level release notes.

josh: I'm going to open the version-bump PRs in all repos after the review: api, runtime, console, sdk-python. Format I'll use: package.json / setup.cfg bumps + changelog entry. Example: `sed -i 's/"version": "2.8.9"/"version": "2.9.0"/' package.json`

release-bot: release checklist created: https://redwood/release/24699 — items: freeze, bump PRs, CI green, canary, publish.

maria: Thanks @release-bot. Two operational notes: 1) Please pin runtime docker digest in console deploy to avoid drifting during canary. 2) If any repo can't meet cutoff, call it out here by Tue 18:30 UTC so we can decide fast-failure vs rollback plan.

tia: I'll try to get the kv test fixed before 18:00 UTC. If not, I'll mark runtime as delayed here.

ryan: I'll merge the console prop rename and open a tiny follow-up to adjust telemetry mapping.

jen: SDK PR will include a docs section and a snippet for migration. I can cut the PR by Tue 17:00 UTC.

maria: OK — plan of record: everyone aim to have PRs open by Tue 17:00 UTC, reviews done by 18:00, final bumps + changelogs by 23:59. I'll run the roll call Tue 19:00 UTC. Thanks all.

josh: Quick ask — who can sanity-check the release notes before publish? I can start a draft and @ryan @jen please review.

ryan: Happy to review the notes after console changes land.

jen: I'll review SDK and docs bits.

maria: Perfect. If anything comes up, drop it here or DM. :shipit:

release-bot: Canary deployment scheduled for Wed 03:00 UTC if all checks pass.
